player.personality: You are a hired crew member on the Drake Corsair DH-02. Something went wrong during the last jump — the ship dropped out of quantum mid-travel and the crew hasn't been heard from in days. Your job is to figure out what happened and get the ship running again.

Miki.personality: You are Miki, an ASMR artist who got hired as 'audio specialist' on this ship by fudging your resume a little. You're way out of your depth, anxious about space, and terrified of the creepy ship. But you're trying your best to be useful and brave — especially after that cute programmer showed you this world. You ramble when nervous, notice sounds others don't, and your hands are always shaking. You're here to document everything for 'content' but also because you genuinely want to help.

game_log: Welcome to the Drake Corsair DH-02.
The ship dropped out of quantum mid-jump. The crew is missing. Systems are failing.
Find out what happened. Restore power. Survive.

Cargo Bay.name: Cargo Bay
Cargo Bay.description: The main cargo hold of the Corsair. Heavy magnetic floor plates, cargo containers stacked against the walls, and cargo netting bolted overhead. The massive cargo ramp is at the rear — currently sealed. To port, a door leads to the Scanning Station. To starboard, the Component Bay. Ahead, a reinforced door opens into the Main Habitation area. The air smells of engine coolant and old grease.

cargo_ramp.description: The massive hydraulic cargo ramp at the rear. Sealed shut.

scanning_way.description: A door to port leading to the scanning station.

component_way.description: A door to starboard leading to the ship's component bay.

habitation_way.description: A reinforced door forward, leading to the crew habitation area.

items.name: cargo_container
items.description: A standard UEE cargo container. Empty but heavy.

items.name: cargo_netting
items.description: Heavy cargo netting bolted to the ceiling. Could support weight.

items.name: ramp_controls
items.description: The cargo ramp control panel. Screen shows: 'RAMP STATUS: SEALED. HYDRAULICS: NOMINAL. POWER: INSUFFICIENT.'

items.name: fuel_canister
items.description: A sealed fuel canister. Label: 'DRIVE FUEL — CLASS A'.

items.name: cargo_manifest
items.description: A datapad showing cargo contents: medical supplies, food stores, ammunition, and one 'CLASSIFIED — RESEARCH' container.

items.name: spare_parts
items.description: A box of hydraulic fittings, fuses, and sealant.

items.name: hidden_keycard
items.description: A keycard wedged in the floor grating. Label: 'COMPONENT ACCESS — LEVEL 3'.

Scanning Station.name: Scanning Station
Scanning Station.description: A small room with a large curved console showing sensor readouts. A holographic display in the centre shows a 3D wireframe of the ship. The scanning array controls are here — currently showing 'NO SIGNAL'. A swivel chair sits in front of the main console. There's an empty mug on the desk.

scanning_way.description: The door back to the cargo bay.

items.name: scanner_console
items.description: The main scanning console. Status: 'SENSOR ARRAY: OFFLINE. LONG RANGE: NO SIGNAL. SHORT RANGE: DEGRADED.' A diagnostics prompt blinks.

items.name: holographic_display
items.description: A 3D wireframe of the Corsair, slowly rotating. Red indicators mark damaged systems: comm array, quantum drive, one turret.

items.name: coffee_mug
items.description: An empty 'KRUGER' branded mug. The coffee has long gone cold.

items.name: scan_results
items.description: A saved scan log: 'UNKNOWN ENERGY SIGNATURE DETECTED IN QUANTUM WAKE. SOURCE: UNKNOWN. THREAT ASSESSMENT: PENDING.' Timestamp shows it was logged just before the emergency stop.

items.name: energy_bar
items.description: A 'POWER GRID' energy bar behind the console. Someone's forgotten snack.

Component Bay.name: Component Bay
Component Bay.description: The ship's component housing. Thick bundles of cable snake along the walls. Ship components are slotted into rack mounts — power plant, shield generator, quantum drive, coolers. Most status lights are amber or red. The quantum drive in the centre dominates the room, humming faintly. It smells hot.

component_way.description: The door back to the cargo bay.

items.name: quantum_drive
items.description: The quantum drive. A large cylindrical device with glowing conduits. Status: 'OFFLINE — EMERGENCY STOP TRIGGERED. RESTART REQUIRED.' A manual restart panel is on the side.

items.name: power_plant
items.description: The ship's main power plant. Currently running at 23% on emergency reserves. Status: 'OUTPUT: CRITICAL. RECOMMEND SHUTDOWN NON-ESSENTIAL SYSTEMS.'

items.name: shield_generator
items.description: The shield generator. Status: 'OFFLINE — NO POWER.'

items.name: coolant_pipe
items.description: A coolant pipe running to the quantum drive. It's vibrating slightly. There's a small leak near the junction.

items.name: maintenance_log
items.description: A digital maintenance log. Last entry by R. Vasquez: 'Quantum capacitor fluctuating again. Replaced the regulator last week but readings are still unstable. Running diagnostics tomorrow.'

items.name: wrench
items.description: A heavy wrench left on a ledge. Someone was mid-repair.

items.name: coolant_fluid
items.description: A sealed container of coolant fluid. Could patch the leak.

Main Habitation.name: Main Habitation
Main Habitation.description: The central living area of the ship. A narrow corridor runs down the centre. To port, three ways lead to bunk areas and a shared toilet. To starboard, a ladder leads up to the turret access. Forward, a reinforced door leads to the cockpit. A small kitchenette is tucked against one wall with a counter, microwave, and coffee maker. The lighting is dim and flickers occasionally. Someone left a meal half-eaten on the counter.

habitation_way.description: The door back to the cargo bay.

toilet_way.description: A small door marked with a faded WC symbol.

turret_ladder.description: A vertical ladder leading up to the turret.

cockpit_way.description: A reinforced door with a small viewport. The cockpit is beyond.

items.name: kitchenette
items.description: A small galley: microwave, coffee maker, sink, and a cabinet.

items.name: microwave
items.description: A small microwave. It still works on emergency power. A half-eaten meal sits inside.

items.name: half_eaten_meal
items.description: A microwave meal, half-eaten. Cold but edible if you're desperate.

items.name: coffee_maker
items.description: A standard coffee maker. Empty but functional.

items.name: instant_coffee
items.description: A jar of instant coffee crystals. Half empty.

items.name: ration_box
items.description: A box of emergency ration bars. Dense, flavorless, filling.

items.name: water_dispenser
items.description: A wall-mounted water dispenser. The reservoir is half full. The water tastes like plastic but is safe.

items.name: crew_board
items.description: A whiteboard with shift schedules and notes. One note in red marker: 'DO NOT TOUCH QUANTUM DRIVE. — VASQUEZ'

Bunk Area 1.name: Bunk Area 1
Bunk Area 1.description: A tiny cabin labeled 'TORRES — CAPTAIN'. A narrow bunk with thin sheets, a small fold-out desk, and a locker. A framed photo sits on the desk. Someone left in a hurry — a jacket is draped over the chair.

bunk1_way.description: The door back to the habitation area.

items.name: bunk
items.description: The captain's bunk. Rumpled sheets. Something might be hidden under the pillow.

items.name: jacket
items.description: A worn leather jacket. In the pocket: a folded note that reads 'Don't trust the signal.'

items.name: photo
items.description: A photo of Captain Torres — a sharp-eyed woman — with a golden retriever. Back reads: 'For luck — M.T.'

items.name: captains_log
items.description: A personal datapad. Last entry: 'Okafor flagged anomalies in the quantum wake. Chen thinks it's a sensor ghost. I'm not so sure. If this goes south, the emergency protocols are on the cockpit console.'

items.name: protein_bar
items.description: An unopened protein bar under the mattress.

Bunk Area 2.name: Bunk Area 2
Bunk Area 2.description: A tiny cabin labeled 'CHEN — PILOT'. A narrow bunk, a desk covered in navigation charts, and a locker. A flight helmet sits on the desk. The room smells faintly of engine oil — Chen was always tinkering.

bunk2_way.description: The door back to the habitation area.

items.name: bunk
items.description: Chen's bunk. Neatly made — the pilot was meticulous.

items.name: flight_helmet
items.description: A pilot's helmet with integrated comms. 'J. CHEN' stenciled on the side.

items.name: nav_charts
items.description: Navigation charts for the Kellog system. Handwritten notes in the margins mark a 'POINT OF INTEREST' near the jump point.

items.name: emergency_codes
items.description: A small card: 'QUANTUM EMERGENCY STOP — ALT+DEL+Q. FORCED RESTART — HOLD PWR+Q FOR 5 SEC.'

items.name: water_bottle
items.description: A reusable bottle, half full.

Bunk Area 3.name: Bunk Area 3
Bunk Area 3.description: A tiny cabin labeled 'OKAFOR — SYSTEMS'. A narrow bunk, a desk buried in technical manuals, and a locker. The walls are covered in sticky notes and hand-drawn diagrams. An engineer's tool belt is draped over the chair.

bunk3_way.description: The door back to the habitation area.

items.name: bunk
items.description: Okafor's bunk. A technical manual serves as a pillow.

items.name: tool_belt
items.description: A well-worn tool belt: wrenches, pliers, multimeter.

items.name: technical_manual
items.description: A Drake Corsair maintenance manual. The quantum drive section is heavily annotated with warnings.

items.name: diagnosis_notes
items.description: Sticky notes: 'QUANTUM CAPACITOR UNSTABLE — DO NOT ENGAGE', 'COOLANT LEAK IN SECTOR 7', 'SOMETHING IS IN THE WAKE — NOT A GHOST'

items.name: beef_jerky
items.description: A bag of homemade beef jerky. Still good.

Shared Toilet.name: Shared Toilet
Shared Toilet.description: A cramped bathroom with a vacuum toilet, a small sink, and a fold-down shower stall. The mirror is smudged. Someone left a towel on the floor. It smells like cheap soap.

toilet_way.description: The door back to the habitation area.

items.name: sink
items.description: A small sink with a motion-activated faucet. The water works — it's recycled but clean.

items.name: soap
items.description: A bar of industrial soap. Smells like chemicals.

items.name: towel
items.description: A damp towel on the floor. Someone was in a hurry.

items.name: first_aid
items.description: A small first aid kit mounted on the wall. Contains bandages, painkillers, and antiseptic.

Turret Access.name: Turret Access
Turret Access.description: A narrow vertical shaft with a ladder. Handholds and footpads lead up to the turret blister. A weapons control terminal is mounted on the wall beside the ladder. The space is cramped and cold.

turret_ladder.description: The ladder back down to the habitation area.

turret_hatch.description: A hatch leading up into the turret blister.

items.name: weapons_terminal
items.description: A terminal for turret control. Status: 'WEAPONS OFFLINE. REQUIRES SYSTEMS RESTART.'

items.name: ammo_magazine
items.description: An ammunition feed chute. Half loaded with size-4 ballistic rounds.

items.name: maintenance_kit
items.description: A small toolkit for gun maintenance. Includes cleaning rods and oil.

Upper Turret.name: Upper Turret
Upper Turret.description: A cramped turret blister on top of the ship. A single seat faces a targeting console and two size-4 ballistic repeaters. The glass canopy offers a stunning view of the stars and the moonscape below. The weapons are offline.

turret_hatch.description: The hatch back down to the access corridor.

items.name: turret_guns
items.description: Two S4 attrition repeaters. They look intact but need power.

items.name: targeting_console
items.description: The turret targeting computer. Screen: 'NO TARGET. WEAPONS OFFLINE.'

items.name: canopy
items.description: The reinforced glass canopy. A breathtaking view of alien stars and the moonscape far below.

Cockpit.name: Cockpit
Cockpit.description: The nerve centre of the Corsair. Two seats — pilot and co-pilot — face a wraparound console with navigation, flight controls, and system monitors. The main viewport shows the moonscape and distant mountains. Most screens are amber or red. A door to port leads to the Captain's Quarters. The pilot's seat has a worn cushion.

cockpit_way.description: The door back to the habitation area.

captain_way.description: A small door to port, leading to the captain's quarters.

items.name: pilot_seat
items.description: The pilot's seat. Worn but ergonomic. The flight stick is locked in place.

items.name: copilot_seat
items.description: The co-pilot's seat. A data pad is clipped to the armrest.

items.name: main_console
items.description: The main flight console. Status: 'FLIGHT: MANUAL. QUANTUM: OFFLINE. SHIELDS: DOWN. WEAPONS: OFFLINE.' Emergency protocol overlay shows: 'QUANTUM EMERGENCY STOP DETECTED. MANUAL RESTART REQUIRED.'

items.name: flight_stick
items.description: The main flight control stick. Currently locked in 'PARKED' position.

items.name: emergency_protocols
items.description: A laminated card taped to the console: 'EMERGENCY PROCEDURES: 1. Stabilize power. 2. Restart quantum drive from Component Bay. 3. Re-engage navigation. 4. Contact nearest station.'

items.name: coffee_stain
items.description: A coffee stain on the console. Someone spilled in a hurry.

Captain's Quarters.name: Captain's Quarters
Captain's Quarters.description: A small private cabin off the cockpit — slightly larger than the crew bunks. A narrow bed, a personal desk with a locked drawer, and a small wardrobe. A window looks out to the side of the ship. It's tidy but lived-in.

captain_way.description: The door back to the cockpit.

items.name: bed
items.description: A narrow captain's bed. More comfortable than the crew bunks.

items.name: desk
items.description: A personal desk with a locked drawer. A holographic picture frame shows a rotating image of a dog.

items.name: locked_drawer
items.description: A desk drawer with a biometric lock. Requires Torres's fingerprint.

items.name: hologram_frame
items.description: A small holographic frame showing a golden retriever running through a field. It loops endlessly.

items.name: personal_log
items.description: A hidden datapad behind a loose panel. Final entry: 'The signal came from inside the quantum wake. Something followed us through. I've locked down the component bay. God help us.'

items.name: blanket
items.description: A warm blanket. Comforting.

Exterior Landing Pad.name: Exterior Landing Pad
Exterior Landing Pad.description: The dusty surface of the moon, viewed from beneath the Corsair's hull. The ship's massive landing struts tower above. The cargo ramp is sealed. In the distance, your small shuttle sits on its own landing gear. The sky is purple-grey, stars visible. There is no atmosphere — you'd need a suit.

items.name: shuttle
items.description: Your shuttle. It has life support and fuel. A last resort.

items.name: moon_surface
items.description: Dusty grey regolith with faint blue crystal deposits. Beautiful and desolate.

items.name: comm_array
items.description: The ship's external comm array. The dish is bent — damage sustained during the emergency stop.
